states.caption: Move 22 (Nigel to play, up 379-326). Rack AEELLNT, 7 tiles in the bag. Mike's rack is unseen.
What happened: Nigel drew the C and played CLAN (making CLOSE across row 12), leaving one tile in the bag.
Mike bingos RELISTEN; Nigel answers with his own out-bingo ENTAILER (hooking the R) to win 495-412.
